strapiBlog.title: Breaking Records: Zoya Ventures Real Estate Sells 8 Full Buildings in Expo City
strapiBlog.short_description: In the ever-dynamic landscape of Dubai real estate, milestones are measured not only by numbers but by the impact they create.

data.text:
In the ever-dynamic landscape of Dubai real estate, milestones are measured not only by numbers but by the impact they create. Zoya Ventures Real Estate has reached a major milestone by selling 8 full buildings in Expo City Dubai within just six months.

This record-breaking success highlights our strength in driving exceptional results for investors and clients alike. Let’s find out more about what made this achievement possible and how it can open doors for future investors.

Expo City Dubai: A Hotspot for Investment

Expo City Dubai continues to attract investors worldwide with its strategic location, world-class infrastructure, and sustainable master planning. The city’s rapid growth has turned it into a magnet for both individual investors and institutions seeking long-term value.

Our recent Dubai real estate record sale reflects this momentum and the trust clients place in Zoya Ventures Real Estate when it comes to navigating Expo City Dubai property sales.

The Power Agents Behind the Success

At the heart of this accomplishment are Zoya Ventures Real Estate’s high-performing agents whose expertise, dedication, and multicultural communication skills helped secure these milestone transactions:

  • Kamil Magomedov: Senior Associate who successfully sold 4 buildings. With deep expertise in the Russian market alongside strong regional knowledge, Kamil connected with investors and delivered strong results.
  • Mariami Amiryan: Primary Sales Consultant who closed deals on 2 buildings. Her knowledge of the Spanish and Russian markets allows her to tap into diverse investor segments and bring them closer to Expo City Dubai opportunities.
  • Walid Alok: Investment Advisor who sold 2 buildings in Expo City. Walid’s track record speaks volumes, having previously single-handedly closed multiple building deals within weeks, including full buildings sold in under 40 days. His expertise spans both European and Arab markets, making him a formidable force in Dubai real estate.

Together, this team exemplifies Zoya Ventures Real Estate’s culture of excellence, dedication, and innovative client solutions.

More Than Sales: Setting Standards in Dubai Real Estate

Beyond the impressive numbers, this achievement represents Zoya Ventures Real Estate’s unwavering commitment to redefining real estate standards in Dubai. As the most awarded brokerage company of 2024 and a recognized market leader, we combine deep insights with unmatched service to deliver not just transactions but long-term value for homeowners and investors alike.

Today, Zoya Ventures Real Estate's Expo City sales serve as a benchmark of how strategic expertise can create momentum in one of Dubai’s most ambitious communities.

Our achievements are a reflection of our people, our clients, and our shared belief in the transformative potential of Dubai real estate. With every milestone, we continue to set higher standards for what is possible.

faqs.question: What makes Expo City Dubai a good investment?

data.answer: Expo City Dubai offers world-class infrastructure, sustainable design, and unmatched connectivity. Its position as a legacy development of Expo 2020 ensures continued global interest and high growth potential.

faqs.question: How many buildings did Zoya Ventures Real Estate sell in Expo City Dubai?

data.answer: Zoya Ventures Real Estate achieved a record by selling 8 full buildings in just 6 months, making it one of the fastest and most significant property sales accomplishments in the area.

data.answer: Our team of expert advisors is ready to guide investors through tailored opportunities in Dubai and beyond. Reach out to Zoya Ventures Real Estate to explore available options today.
